provenance.description: Authored hosting incident for development. All identifiers, customer statements, and log entries are fictional; this is not a reproduced fault or a real customer ticket.

incident.title: Online shop returns HTTP 500 during checkout
incident.description: Since about 09:10 UTC this morning, customers can browse our shop but cannot finish a purchase. Clicking Place order shows a blank page or a 500 error. We updated the checkout extension shortly before this started. Retrying has not helped. We do not know whether any orders were saved.

context.reported_change: Customer reports updating a checkout extension at approximately 09:05 UTC; not independently verified.
context.reported_impact: Checkout unavailable; browsing still works. Order persistence and affected customer count are unknown.
